Meet the Baker

Your Local Cake Artist

Baked Creations is a Burntwood-based home bakery specializing in cakes, cupcakes, and sweet treats for every occasion.

Every order is made fresh and finished with care, whether it is a birthday cake or a tray of cupcakes for a celebration.
